args.command:
br create "Identify WorkerPool edge cases needing test coverage" "## Scope
- Review internal/bridge/worker_pool.go implementation
- Review existing integration tests in integration_test.go
- Identify specific edge cases not covered by current tests
- Focus on DB state transitions and validation logic gaps

## Acceptance Criteria
- Documented list of 5-10 specific edge cases needing tests
- Each edge case has a clear description and why it needs testing
- Edge cases are categorized by type (DB state, validation, error handling)

## Notes
This is a planning bead - no code changes, just investigation and documentation."
args.description: Create child bead 1: Identify edge cases

args.command:
br create "Add WorkerPool DB state transition tests" "## Scope
- Write integration tests for WorkerPool database state transitions
- Test worker creation, state updates, and cleanup
- Verify database records match expected states

## Specific Tests
- Test worker record creation with correct initial state
- Test worker state transitions (pending → running → complete/error)
- Test worker cleanup and record deletion
- Test concurrent worker state updates
- Test worker orphan detection and handling

## Acceptance Criteria
- All DB state transition edge cases from child 1 have tests
- Tests follow existing integration_test.go patterns
- Each test verifies both in-memory state and database records
- Tests pass with \`go test -v ./internal/bridge/...\`
- Each test runs in <5 seconds

## Depends On
- Child from 'Identify WorkerPool edge cases needing test coverage'"
args.description: Create child bead 2: DB state transition tests

args.command:
br create "Add WorkerPool validation logic tests" "## Scope
- Write integration tests for WorkerPool input and constraint validation
- Test parameter validation, bounds checking, and edge case validation

## Specific Tests
- Test invalid worker parameters (negative counts, zero limits)
- Test concurrent worker limit enforcement
- Test session ID validation
- Test timeout boundary conditions
- Test empty/null parameter handling

## Acceptance Criteria
- All validation logic edge cases from child 1 have tests
- Tests verify validation errors are returned correctly
- Tests follow existing integration_test.go patterns
- Tests pass with \`go test -v ./internal/bridge/...\`
- Each test runs in <5 seconds

## Depends On
- Child from 'Add WorkerPool DB state transition tests'"
args.description: Create child bead 3: Validation logic tests

args.command:
br create "Add WorkerPool error handling and cleanup tests" "## Scope
- Write integration tests for WorkerPool error scenarios and cleanup edge cases
- Test failure modes, timeout handling, and resource cleanup

## Specific Tests
- Test worker timeout scenarios
- Test worker process failure handling
- Test cleanup on session closure
- Test cleanup on bridge shutdown
- Test partial failure scenarios (some workers fail, some succeed)

## Acceptance Criteria
- All error handling edge cases from child 1 have tests
- Tests verify proper cleanup and error propagation
- Tests follow existing integration_test.go patterns
- Tests pass with \`go test -v ./internal/bridge/...\`
- Each test runs in <5 seconds

## Depends On
- Child from 'Add WorkerPool validation logic tests'"
